compatibility_fingerprint.bundle_binding: this file and artifact-format.json are both covered by the final evidence checksum manifest
required_classes: OverlayFS mount options and module parameters

permitted_variable_and_recorded_but_git_: configured controller uid and gid values (fixed within a run, variable across compatible deployments, and Git-ignored)
atime, mtime, ctime, and birth time
allocation size, blocks, block size, and statx attributes
user.* and named POSIX ACL xattrs

impure.intermediate_policy: E05/E08 transition checkpoints are exact closed occurrence sets; other intermediate impure occurrences are value/path-family validated and losslessly recorded as observed advisory forms, not claimed as required tuples
impure.name: trusted.overlay.impure
impure.replay_disposition: preserve exactly on the recorded directory; OverlayFS uses it as directory-merge bookkeeping

frozen_grammar.marker_checkpoint_rule: no OverlayFS control marker is valid at P00-before-mount

opaque.name: trusted.overlay.opaque
opaque.replay_disposition: preserve exactly; the opaque directory hides the corresponding lower directory contents

directory.empty_directory: permitted but absent from the Git-tree oracle
directory.permission_bits: permitted but Git-ignored; replay normalizes ordinary directories to 0755
directory.tree_position: significant for upper reconstruction and OverlayFS control semantics

path.form: canonical relative components; no empty, dot, dot-dot, slash-containing component, or NUL

regular.content: significant; exact length and SHA-256-bound bytes
regular.execute_class: significant; executable iff any of mode bits 0111 is set
regular.other_permission_bits: permitted but Git-ignored; replay normalizes nonexecutables to 0644 and executables to 0755

ordinary_xattrs.disposition: record losslessly; not interpreted as OverlayFS control metadata

origin.intermediate_policy: E05/E08 transition checkpoints are exact closed occurrence sets; other intermediate origin occurrences are structurally/path-family validated and losslessly recorded as observed advisory forms, not claimed as required tuples
origin.name: trusted.overlay.origin
origin.replay_disposition: preserve the captured bytes when an upper is reproduced, but validate structurally and ignore the opaque file-handle tail for Git identity/semantic comparison under index=off,nfs_export=off,metacopy=off,xino=off

redirect.name: trusted.overlay.redirect
redirect.replay_disposition: preserve exact bytes before mount; OverlayFS follows the redirected lower directory, then upper children override matching lower children, whiteouts suppress matching lower children, and opaque=y hides remaining lower children

syntax.relative: canonical path resolved from the containing lower directory
syntax.root_anchored: one leading slash; canonical path resolved from the overlay root

frozen_grammar.scope: closed Stage 0 catalog grammar for the qualified ext4/OverlayFS profile

stopped_workdir.capture: all entries and metadata are retained; capture errors are forbidden
stopped_workdir.persistence: only the upper semantic signature must remain stable across remount; work internals may be consumed or rewritten by OverlayFS

post_mount_stopped.kernel_private_descendants: captured losslessly but never parsed; their names, types, metadata, and presence may change during a successful remount

stopped_workdir.replay_disposition: never parse or replay work contents; retain the paired workdir only for remounting the same upper, and create a fresh empty workdir for a new generation
